title: Cross-Stack Standard project manifest
description: The manifest at .cross-stack/standard.json: which version of the Standard a project adopted, its tracks, profile, tier and modules, and the settings of the Standard's hooks.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion. Pin it to the adopted version.

version.description: The SemVer version of the Standard the project adopted; the upgrade skill reads it.

tracks.description: Stacks present in the project: laravel (JSON API), web (Next.js or React), mobile (Expo).

trackRoots.description: The project-relative directory of each track whose files do not sit at the project root (a directory, or a list of them); a track without an entry uses the project root.

profile.description: Web profile: next (App Router) or react-spa (Vite). Only valid with the web track; defaults to next.

tier.description: Tier 1: the invariants only. Tier 2: the full Standard, for projects that are multi-tenant, have more than one developer, or are long-lived. When absent, Claude asks.

modules.description: Optional modules. Each is true or false, or an object whose "enabled" defaults to true.

locales.description: BCP 47 language tags in canonical form, such as en or ar-SA. The first entry is the source locale.

companions.description: The user's answer, per companion plugin, to adopt's install question: true approved and installed, false declined. A declined companion is never installed, and its tools are refused in this project.

disabled.description: true turns every hook of the Standard off for this project.

hooks.description: Settings for the Standard's Claude Code hooks. Environment variables override them.

detect.description: Detect the project's tracks at session start and add a short reminder.

phpstan.description: Also run PHPStan on each edited PHP file. Off by default because it is slow.

budgetSeconds.description: Time budget in seconds for formatting and linting one edited file.

enabled.description: Run the fast gate when Claude finishes a turn. CROSS_STACK_STANDARD_STOP_GATE=0 turns it off.

budgetSeconds.description: Time budget in seconds for the fast gate.

command.description: The name of the composer and/or npm script the fast gate runs: a script name, not a shell command.

protect.description: Extra project-relative globs whose edits need confirmation, added to the built-in list.

protectCommands.description: Extra JavaScript regular expressions for shell commands that need confirmation, added to the built-in list.

decision.description: The answer to a protected tool call: ask (the user confirms) or deny (blocked, also in bypassPermissions mode; the user makes the change directly).

browserHosts.description: Development hosts the Chrome DevTools MCP companion may open without asking, added to the built-in local hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], *.localhost, *.test). A leading *. matches any subdomain.

allowlistsDir.description: A project-relative directory (no leading /, no .. segment, no glob characters) that holds the allowlist files, <RULE-ID>.json.

allowlistMaxDays.description: The furthest ahead an allowlist entry's expiry date may lie, in days from today (UTC). A date further ahead is a finding, so an exception cannot be made permanent by a far-future date.

stack.description: Settings of the one-library-per-concern check. Each key other than competingGroups names a concern (state, server-state, forms, validation, http, dates, styling, unit-tests, e2e-tests) that is being migrated from one library to another.

competingGroups.description: Groups of libraries that compete for one concern, added to the curated catalogue the check ships with.

concern.description: Name of the concern, such as state or dates.

packages.description: Package names (npm or Composer) that compete for the concern.

deprecated.description: Packages being migrated away from; they may stay installed next to the winner until the migration ends.

then.description: The bff-auth module needs the web track with the next profile.
The i18n module needs a "locales" list; its first entry is the source locale.

enabledModule.description: Matches a module setting that turns the module on.

locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag in canonical form, such as en, ar or zh-Hant-TW.

projectGlob.description: A project-relative glob with / separators, no leading / and no .. segment.

trackRoot.description: A project-relative directory (no leading /, no .. segment, no glob characters), or a non-empty list of them.

projectDir.description: A project-relative directory: no leading /, no drive letter, no .. segment, no glob characters.
